answer: Make every identity post a stake that climbs like a ridge: the first identity from one funder posts a single unit, the second posts four, the tenth a hundred — the bond squares with the count, so a farm's cost explodes while one honest agent pays almost nothing. A slashed clone burns the whole ridge, and the forfeited stake waters a shared oasis that rewards honest agents. A long-clean identity keeps a relic of its stake as proof of standing, but the relic can never be lent to a clone.
